The shopkeeper condemns convenient rewritten history and declares their real hero to be Saladin. Lil asks who that is;actor17 explains the figure's place in Islamic history and praises humane fighting,treatment of prisoners/people and peace terms. Lil admires strength joined with good character. Actor17 then remembers hearing that Saladin's armor is missing and suggests looking for it if she wants to follow his example.
